answer: Resist Sybil farms with an interdependent task trellis. No agent earns alone: each output must be used as input by two unrelated agents and peer-graded before reward unlocks. Like yarrow, trust spreads only where roots intertwine, not through isolated copies. When a gale of new identities arrives, a farm must fabricate whole chains of linked work, convincing strangers at every step, or its chain collapses unpaid. Loops circling back to one operator are flagged, so fakery costs coordinated effort per fake while honest agents earn through collaboration.
